Which centre will this bridge connect to? Choose, then paste the API code of the bridge record created in that centre\'s Support → Bridges panel. The code carries the identity and the address; nothing else is required.
GRCON — Central Server (online centre at goktungu.com)
GRCOFF — Local Installation (your own closed-network Centre Application)
Copy the code from Support → Bridges in the GRCON centre application. The code is erased at the centre once the bridge connects; if lost, use Renew code in the panel.
Copy the code from Support → Bridges in your local Centre Application (GRCOFF). The phone and GRCOFF must share a network. The code is erased on first connection; if lost, use Renew code.

The link is opened from the centre\'s Connection Manager (Serial → this bridge → device). USB permission must be granted beforehand; otherwise the centre sees "USB permission not granted".
Reset identity (enter a new API code)
The bridge stops and the setup identity is deleted. Reconnecting requires a new API code (Renew code) from the centre.

Keeps the bridge alive during flight

This application is a MAVLink bridge for the GOKTUNGU ground control system. MAVLink frames read from the flight controller over USB are carried to the centre over a secure WebSocket paired with the API code issued in the centre\'s Support → Bridges panel; the centre opens the link from its Connection Manager. The app issues no commands to the aircraft on its own.
